title: 第三章石头里的大圣第四章斗战圣法
content_zh:
“大圣，不要再说了。那三年时光，我永生难忘！只要前辈你能有办法，恢复我体内的至尊之血，让我能够报了此仇，往后甘愿为前辈做牛做马！”
苏阳咬牙切齿道。
“嘿嘿，做牛做马就算了。以你的修为，本大圣还看不上呢。不过，要不是你体内的至尊之血，本大圣也不会这么快苏醒。说起来，倒也要感谢你。”
“等会我就让你体内恢复血气。到时候，你找个没人地方先躲起来吧。”
话落，苏阳便感觉到一股熟悉的热流正涌入自己的体内，通过奇经八脉遍布四肢百骸。原本骨瘦如柴的身躯，也开始生长出血肉，气血也在逐渐恢复......
如新生的春笋一般，生机苏醒，源源不断。
很快，苏阳便能够站起来，从水潭里游上了岸边，跪在地上，看着自己充满血肉的双手，瞳孔之中充了兴奋之色。
“我....我恢复血肉了！！”
“哈哈哈哈！我恢复血肉了，我的至尊之血还没有枯竭！！！”
苏阳双眼微红，两行热泪缓缓流出。
他想要大声呼喊，发泄内心之中这么多年遭受到的非常人折磨。
可是他忍住了，他知道，自己只是恢复了血肉之躯，体内并无半点灵气，若是此刻大声呼唤，招来了妖兽的话，怕是真要成为妖兽的盘中餐，屁下屎了。
“小子，别高兴的太早了。这附近可是有一头强大的妖兽存在，而且距离你不远，若是不想再死一次的话，就赶紧找个地方先躲起来吧。”石头里的大圣声音，再度响起道。
苏阳闻言，也急忙起身，左顾右盼后，刚好看见水潭旁边不远处，有个小石洞。
石洞不大，正好能够容纳苏阳进去。
于是，苏阳便钻进了石洞之中，可刚进去没三秒，苏阳便如风一般的往外狂奔，在其屁股后面，跟着一头凶狠的野狼。
“艹！该死的畜生。”苏阳忍不住骂道。
“.....你丫的好歹身怀至尊血脉，虽然现在体内没有灵气，但也不至于连一头野兽都搞不定吧？”无语的声音再度在苏阳脑海中响起。
苏阳闻言，急忙停住逃跑的脚步发愣道：“是哦。我现在已经恢复了血肉之躯，怎会惧怕一头野兽呢？”
“该死！”

苏阳也觉得自己有些太过软弱了。似乎三年的圈养，已经让他忘记了战斗的热血！
“嗷呜！”野狼龇着牙，绿油油的眼睛死死盯着苏阳。
“哼！差点被你个畜生给吓跑了。刚好，我好久没尝过野兽的滋味，今日就拿你找回从前的感觉吧！”苏阳紧握双拳，久违的力量涌遍全身。
“喝呀~”
一声怒吼后，身形闪动，右手出拳，朝着野狼脑袋狠狠的砸了过去。
看似普通的一拳，却掀起了破空之声。野狼似乎也察觉到了眼前的人类不一般，想要转身逃跑，却发现浑身无法动弹，只能惨叫一声后，被苏阳的一拳直接轰飞在石洞上方，缓缓下落。
脑袋如西瓜一般碎裂....红的白的夹杂在一起缓缓流出。
content_en:
"Great Sage, don't talk anymore. I will never forget those three years! As long as you, senior, can find a way to restore the blood of the Supreme in my body, so that I can avenge this, I will be willing to work hard for my senior in the future!"
Su Yang gritted his teeth and said.
"Hehe, forget about being a cow or a horse. With your cultivation, this great sage doesn't look down on you. However, if it weren't for the supreme blood in your body, this great sage would not wake up so quickly. Speaking of which, I would like to thank you."
"I will restore the blood in your body later. When the time comes, you can find a place where no one is and hide first."
As soon as he finished speaking, Su Yang felt a familiar heat flowing into his body, spreading throughout his limbs and bones through the eight extraordinary meridians. The originally skinny body began to grow flesh and blood, and the blood and vitality were gradually recovering...
Like newly born bamboo shoots, vitality is awakening and flowing continuously.
Soon, Su Yang was able to stand up and swam from the pool to the shore. He knelt on the ground and looked at his hands full of flesh and blood, his pupils filled with excitement.
"I...I have recovered my flesh and blood!!"
"Hahahaha! I have recovered my flesh and blood, and my supreme blood has not dried up yet!!!"
Su Yang's eyes were slightly red, and two lines of hot tears slowly flowed out.
He wanted to shout loudly and vent the extraordinary torture he had suffered in his heart for so many years.
But he held back. He knew that he had only restored his flesh and blood body, and there was no aura in his body. If he called out loudly at this moment and attracted the monster, he might really become the monster's meal and get shit.
"Boy, don't get too happy too soon. There is a powerful demonic beast nearby, and it's not far from you. If you don't want to die again, just find a place to hide first." The voice of the Great Sage in the stone sounded again.
When Su Yang heard this, he stood up in a hurry. After looking around, he happened to see a small stone cave not far from the pool.
The cave is not big, just big enough to accommodate Su Yang.
So, Su Yang got into the cave, but within three seconds of entering, Su Yang ran out like the wind, with a ferocious wild wolf following behind him.
"Fuck! Damn beast." Su Yang couldn't help but curse.
"...After all, you have the blood of the Supreme. Although there is no spiritual energy in your body now, you can't even handle a beast, right?" The speechless voice sounded in Su Yang's mind again.
When Su Yang heard this, he hurriedly stopped his escape and said in a daze, "Yes. Now that I have recovered my flesh and blood, how can I be afraid of a wild beast?"
"Damn it!"
Su Yang also felt that he was a little too weak. It seems that three years of captivity have made him forget the passion of fighting!
"Ouch!" The wild wolf bared its teeth and stared at Su Yang with its green eyes.
"Hmph! I almost scared you away, you beast. It just so happens that I haven't tasted the taste of a wild beast for a long time. I'll use you to get back my old feelings today!" Su Yang clenched his fists, and the long-lost strength surged through his body.
"Drink~"
After roaring, he flashed, punched with his right hand, and hit the wild wolf's head hard.
It seemed like an ordinary punch, but it caused a sound that broke through the air. The wild wolf seemed to have noticed that the human in front of him was unusual. He wanted to turn around and run away, but found that he could not move. He could only scream and was sent flying above the stone cave by Su Yang's punch, and slowly fell down.
The head shattered like a watermelon...red and white mixed together and slowly flowed out.
